_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 67: 14-22 May 2026. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He says oh God please come and asks whether that would not be cool, that maybe it would be at the end of it, that he has not talked to Sister Billie about that, that maybe it is September the 9th of 2029, and that either way they are in the timeframe, maybe.
mentions.quote: Maybe it's the September the 9th of 2029
mentions.falsify_match: The return on that date.
mentions.falsify_miss: It passes. He hedges it three times in one sentence, with maybe twice and a note that he has not checked with the person he takes the framework from.

mentions.claim_text: He speaks of America with their Clarity Act declaring things, says he saw South Korea and Japan, and reads that Japan will recognise foreign crypto stablecoins as legal payment methods starting June 1st and that the world's fourth largest economy has legalised stablecoins.
mentions.quote: Japan will recognize foreign crypto stablecoins as legal payment methods starting June 1st
mentions.falsify_match: A real dated policy change read out and offered as confirmation of the crypto material.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a: the announcement is already public.

mentions.claim_text: He says it melted your skin and was a horrific death, that it was something with chemical weapons coming out of the Damascus area, and that the Lord warned and said this attack will be worse than the one that happened in October.
mentions.quote: it melted your skin. It was a horrific death
mentions.falsify_match: A chemical attack originating near Damascus.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Ninth telling, and the agent has shifted again: biological in March, chemical here.

mentions.claim_text: He calls him born again and to find Jesus, says there are certain things he is about to stumble upon, names the God particles, and says he sees new things his mind is ticking around and that he realises something.
mentions.quote: There's certain things that he's about to stumble upon. The God particles
mentions.falsify_match: A physics discovery by the man in question.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. He is not named in the passage, and God particle is a press term rather than a physics one.

mentions.claim_text: He prays that they stay on the right track with the Bible, prays over Mel Gibson for the funding and the things he needs, and that this will be used for the greatest harvest mechanism they have ever seen and a tool to bring in the lost.
mentions.quote: We pray over Mel Gibson for the funding
mentions.falsify_match: A named person's film project being funded and used evangelistically.
mentions.falsify_miss: It is not funded or has no such effect. The project is publicly tracked, so this is checkable.

mentions.claim_text: He says they are going to pray over their nation and over the things they believe the Lord is leading them to pray over, and asks what the Lord showed them in the last video they were together.
mentions.quote: the things that we believe the Lord is leading us to pray over
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: the prayer list is assembled from the previous session.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says there is something more to this darkness, that this was 2028, that here they are in May of 2026 so they have some time, and that he believes with all his heart in his opinion what the Lord showed him about the virus coming in the fall.
mentions.quote: this was 2028. here we are in 2026 in May. So, we have some time
mentions.falsify_match: Darkness and a virus in the stated windows.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither. We have some time is the recurring move: the threat is real but not yet, so nothing comes due.

mentions.claim_text: He reads that something may indicate alien technology and says that is pretty cool, asks what kind of technology it is and suggests lasers, and says he told them they were scanning these black things with the writings on them.
mentions.quote: that may indicate alien technology
mentions.falsify_match: A news item about anomalous objects offered as confirmation of an earlier sighting.
mentions.falsify_miss: The earlier telling does not describe it.

mentions.claim_text: He says it was a good video with a lot of things in it but that it was just a dark video, that what the Lord showed him is sad, that the darkness is 2028 and they are praying over it, and that they are getting to that point for the next shmita cycle.
mentions.quote: it's darkness is 2028 praying over it
mentions.falsify_match: A dark year in 2028 running into the cycle.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Darkness remains undefined across every telling.

mentions.claim_text: He says he means the cruise ships, asks whether it was back in December, says he saw this year, is corrected and says no, not this year, that it was well over a year ago, and asks whether they can find it.
mentions.quote: the cruise ships. It's been well over a year ago
mentions.falsify_match: The original telling is in this corpus and datable, which is how they proceed to settle it.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a. Another instance of a date being reconstructed on air rather than recalled.

mentions.claim_text: He confirms it is about the boat, asks whether it is Royal Caribbean, and they work out that it was December, of 2025, and land on December the 9th, though he thought he saw it last fall.
mentions.quote: Is it Royal Caribbean or what? When was this? This was December
mentions.falsify_match: The 9 December telling is in this corpus and can be read directly.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not describe a cruise ship.

mentions.claim_text: They establish an October 1st sighting of the glory on Royal Caribbean, he confirms he saw the glory and a revival breaking out on the boat, and they note a December 6th sighting of the Caribbean yacht before playing it.
mentions.quote: October 1st, I saw the Glory. A revival breaking out on the boat
mentions.falsify_match: A reported revival aboard a named cruise line.
mentions.falsify_miss: None reported. Three separate dates are assembled here into one claim, and all three tellings are in this corpus.

mentions.claim_text: He prays a hedge of protection over the midterms, that it will be a red wave of good leadership in the Senate, in the House, in the governors and in the mayors, and calls a red wave over this nation.
mentions.quote: WE CALL A RED WAVE OVER THIS NATION
mentions.falsify_match: Republican gains across all four levels named.
mentions.falsify_miss: Losses. The red wave is back as a declaration after five tellings that the Senate goes blue.

mentions.claim_text: He says Brandon Biggs does not have racism in his bones and that he loves them, that it is because he is trying to be politically correct while talking in front of hundreds of thousands of people, and that he may butcher things and then people say something.
mentions.quote: I may butcher things, and then people say
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it is an advance defence against being quoted on the wording of what he says.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says that is interesting and he will not touch any more because the Lord said not to touch that, and that this is the coup, January 6th on steroids, a coup and the 25th Amendment.
mentions.quote: This is the coup. January 6th on steroids. A coup, 25th Amendment
mentions.falsify_match: An attempt to remove the president under the 25th Amendment.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such attempt. Naming the mechanism makes this more specific than the earlier coup material.

mentions.claim_text: He cites that he must work the works of him who sent him while it is day because the night is coming when no one can work, and that as long as he is in the world he is the light of the world, then says he sees the light in 2026 but that he sees darkness.
mentions.quote: the night is coming when no one can work
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: light and darkness together, which between them cover any year.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says they must be busy about their father's business in 2026, repeats that he sees darkness coming, tells them to work while it is day and bring in the harvest across 2026 and 2027, and says there is darkness now.
mentions.quote: Work while it is day. Bring in the harvest
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says it would be amazing when the revival starts because Brother Hagin was talking about it when he spoke to him in heaven in the vision, and that he said the revival lasts for two years, starts this summer and goes all the way.
mentions.quote: the revival last for 2 years. Starts this summer
mentions.falsify_match: A revival beginning in summer 2026 and running two years.
mentions.falsify_miss: None begins. Starts this summer is now stated flatly rather than conditionally, which makes it due from August.

mentions.claim_text: He says that when he hits that wall and gets to November and the election and that timeframe he prays over it, and asks when the shmita cycle is and when Rosh Hashanah of 2028 falls, whether there is a way to find that out yet and whether it is announced, wondering if it is October.
mentions.quote: When is Rosh Hashanah of 2028? Is there a way to find that out yet?
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and worth recording: the Hebrew calendar is fixed and published decades ahead, so the date is not something that needs announcing.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw the Olympics and could see darkness on the Olympics, that something is there, gives the dates as July the 14th to the 30th of 2028, and notes it is the summer months.
mentions.quote: I saw the Olympics. I could see darkness on the Olympics
mentions.falsify_match: An incident at the Los Angeles Olympics.
mentions.falsify_miss: The games pass without one. The dates are read off the published schedule, not seen, and the window is fixed and public.

mentions.claim_text: He recounts someone saying he is freaking them out a little, answers that this is what the Lord said, and that he talked about an asteroid like this rock that is coming, saying he does not know whether it is an asteroid or a meteor.
mentions.quote: he talked about an asteroid like this rock that's coming
mentions.falsify_match: An impact or notable close approach.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. He says he does not know what kind of object it is.

mentions.claim_text: He mentions all this demonic stuff they are talking about, then reads that a newly discovered asteroid designated 2026 JH2 is about to have a very close encounter with the Earth at a distance given in astronomical units.
mentions.quote: newly discovered asteroid 2026 JH2 is about to have a very close encounter
mentions.falsify_match: A second real close approach offered as confirmation within a month of the first.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a: newly discovered near-Earth objects pass regularly and are catalogued as a matter of routine.
